model: Fixed seamless filled square; one scalar drives the entire body and its soft halo. No translation, scaling, rotation or per-cell phase.
measurement: Complete original-PTS decode, preceding source frame sampled every 20ms over the stable 12.40-13.60s cycle. Mean encoded RGB in source x242..269/y167..194, using fixed 0.2126/0.7152/0.0722 luminance weights and normalized to the cycle peak 221.831956. Not source alpha. No minimum brightness is added; the source reaches black. Excludes text entrance and color transition.
runtime_note: Linear interpolation through the last-to-first seam. Phase zero is the observed dark point. Gold tint, DATA STALE text and its pill remain unchanged; only the square and halo breathe.
